dossier.summary: Marlow Fastening is a distributor of industrial fasteners and fittings for machine builders and maintenance teams in the Midwest, with a warehouse in Dayton and same-day pick-up.
dossier.why_now: Posted a role for a digital marketing manager in October.

data.summary: Your homepage opens with Marlow's name and quality fasteners since 1987. The sketch opens with who you serve and the same-day pick-up in Dayton, which today sits in the third paragraph.

today.headline: Quality fasteners and fittings since 1987
today.sub: Marlow Fastening is a family-owned distributor serving customers across the Midwest with a wide selection of industrial products and dependable service.
today.section_body: We offer a comprehensive range of services to meet your needs, including kitting, vendor-managed inventory, and custom sourcing. Our experienced team is committed to providing exceptional service.

sketch.headline: Fasteners for machine builders, picked up same day in Dayton
sketch.sub: Marlow stocks industrial fasteners and fittings for machine builders and maintenance teams across the Midwest, and has since 1987.
sketch.proof: Family owned since 1987, with same-day pick-up at the Dayton warehouse
sketch.image: The pick-up counter at the Dayton warehouse, with a kitted order ready
sketch.section_heading: Three ways Marlow keeps your line running
sketch.section_intro: Beyond the catalogue, Marlow does the work that keeps parts on the shelf before you need them.

points.title: Kitting
points.text: Every fastener for one assembly in one bag, so the build starts without a parts hunt.

points.title: Vendor-managed inventory
points.text: Marlow keeps your bins stocked, so maintenance never waits on a missing bolt.

points.title: Custom sourcing
points.text: The part that is not in the catalogue, found and quoted by the same team that stocks the rest.

notes.note: Says who it is for and the one thing a buyer can check, the same-day pick-up. Today the buyer reads three paragraphs to learn either.
A stock check is what a machine builder wants to do next. Contact us asks them to start a conversation first.
The 1987 line moves out of the headline and under the button, where it backs the promise instead of being the promise.
A picture of the counter shows the pick-up promise. A photo of bolts on a white background would not.
The three services you already list get a line each on what the buyer gets, so a maintenance lead can pick the one they need.
